name: ChartSelector
summary: AI-driven service that selects optimal chart types and visualization configurations for query results
purpose: Determines the most appropriate chart or graph type to represent data based on its structure, dimensions, and semantic context, bridging raw query results with meaningful visual representations
responsibilities: Analyze data characteristics to determine suitable visualization types
Select optimal chart configurations based on query context and user intent
Provide chart recommendations to the AI query service
Map data schemas to supported visualization formats
architecture_notes: Part of the AI service layer implementing the Strategy pattern for visualization selection. Encapsulates chart selection logic separately from query execution and rendering. The pick() method likely serves as the primary entry point following a selector or factory pattern. Positioned between the AI query service and presentation layer to decouple data retrieval from visualization concerns.
improvements: Add caching for repeated data-to-chart mappings to reduce AI inference costs
Implement confidence scoring for chart recommendations
Add support for user feedback loops to improve selection accuracy over time
Consider making the selection algorithm pluggable to support rule-based fallbacks
